value.title: 134 — omp/pi take the extension stream with no composer veto; senders are told when a row is still queued or landed late
value.summary: Route Omp/Pi directly to the queue-backed extension event stream before composer gates; notify senders when queued or delivered late.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: req-0054 (magpie 2026-09-02, msg 888D45C1): a ruling to a working omp returned `queued, reason:human-typing` and delivered on attempt 101, eight minutes late. Omp/Pi must bypass both composer gates and `select_rung`, entering the queue-backed Observe/message.pushed path immediately; the extension claims and acknowledges the row after injecting it at turn end. Correction 2026-09-02: the production `Transport` is Claude-only `UdsTransport`; the Omp/Pi extension stream is the event bus plus inbox claim, not a Transport. A second unit adds sender-visible still-queued and delivered-late notices.

sections.name: goals
value: A message to a working omp/pi seat is handed to the extension stream immediately; no composer capture or human-typing veto for those harnesses.

A row still queued after N seconds (config, default 60) raises a pushed notice to the sender naming msg_id, recipient, reason, attempts, and age; later delivery raises delivered late, and the sender's next pij-rs command prints outstanding notices on stderr.
Claude-harness seats: the human-typing veto considers only recognized non-blank composer-box content; a working seat or streamed output never counts as typing.
A configured retry cap no greater than 30 seconds prevents a cleared veto from remaining queued beyond one cap.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing the veto for Claude/Copilot/Codex panes, where a human composer can exist.
Any OMP extension change beyond what the stream already does.
Restarting the production rs daemon or running any flowspace3 daemon.

value.text: LIVE, dev daemon: hand-started omp in tmux, mid-turn (give it a long task); `pij-rs send` returns delivered (or queued with a reason that is NOT human-typing) and the turn arrives at the end of the current turn — transcript + timestamps pasted; CONTROL on main first: same gesture returns queued/human-typing (pasted).

value.text: LIVE: a send to a Claude seat whose composer holds a draft stays queued (human-typing) — the veto still protects humans; pasted.

LIVE: sender receives `still queued` notice after N s for a row vetoed on a Claude pane, then `delivered late (<delay>)` when it lands; and `pij-rs list` from the sender prints the outstanding notice on stderr; pasted. Unit test for the notice scheduler RED-first.

`harness checks` green on the rebased tree + explicit `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` receipts (use ~/.cargo/bin/cargo); no operator-home writes.

LIVE (magpie is the test seat, both directions, plus two omp seats): a send to a WORKING Claude-harness seat with an EMPTY composer box is delivered by socket and the receipt reason is NEVER `human-typing`; a send to a Claude seat whose composer box holds a real draft still queues `human-typing` AND the receipt carries a sha of the draft. Assert on the REASON string and latency > 0 for the control, not on minutes. RED CONTROL ON RECORD (magpie 2026-09-02, pre-u3): msg EEE16F98 claude→claude, weasel mid-turn, composer `❯ ` empty → reason=human-typing, delivered 6 s later (sent 1788339465, delivered 1788339471).
value.claim: the Claude veto fires on a human draft, never on agent output or seat busyness
value.receipt: Proven by tests + socket delivery; live veto witness at deploy. RED artifact 127; interaction 24/24 and delivery 20/20; magpie confirmed PLAN134-U3-MAGPIE-EMPTY as a 40/40 byte-exact user turn from its accepting socket. See assets/live-proof.md.

value.text: Retry backoff for a vetoed row is bounded and observable: for the same recipient in the same state magpie measured 6 s (EEE16F98) and somewhere between 50 s and ~10 min (sent 1788338783), and this afternoon 8 min / attempt 101 (888D45C1). Requirement: document the backoff curve in the plan, cap the interval (config, default ≤30 s) so a veto that clears is retried within one cap, and expose attempts + next_retry_at on the notice (u2). Test: fake gate vetoes N times then clears; assert delivery within one cap of the clear.
value.claim: backoff cannot turn a 6 s veto into 8 min
